g.text: The sweep moves the BBO past a stale join; a rescan makes it the taker
T buys 500 @ p and sweeps the asks; M's sell join was judged against the old snapshot v
lane FIFOs in [a1, p] for ops
M's sell @ q crosses bid p
while some lane's snap ver < v+1
each rescan step is one slice of at most ARC_STEP_BUDGET_NS,
so a rescan never holds back other lanes' cuts or crosses
